svg.title: Sedjem on GitHub: downloads, stars and forks, clones and page views
svg.desc: Four charts on one time axis, from 26 September 2026 to 11 November 2026. Downloads of the app, all releases, as a running total: 82 on 11 November 2026, recorded since 19 October 2026. Releases: v0.1.0 on 26 September 2026, v0.2.0 on 19 October 2026, v0.3.0 on 29 October 2026, v0.3.1 on 29 October 2026, v0.3.2 on 30 October 2026, v0.3.3-preview.20261107 on 7 November 2026, v0.3.3-preview.20261108 on 8 November 2026, v0.3.3 on 9 November 2026, v0.3.4-preview.20261110 on 10 November 2026. Stars: 9, the first on 28 September 2026. Forks: none yet. Clones per day: 2,395 since 5 October 2026, the most 627 on 30 October 2026. Page views per day: 603 since 5 October 2026, the most 101 on 30 October 2026.
